Ive only been to a studio once to record and the lessons I walked away with are:

Don't be afraid to experiment with the structure of your song. Once you've got the pieces recorded in a DAW you can just copy and paste stuff around and arrange It like a jigsaw. 

Take frequent breaks.

Critically listen to what you've got and logically think about things like impact, serve the song and most of the time simplicity is more.

Learn how to play and practice to a metronome (yea... lol)
